sourceBasis.summary: General Product Posting Group WAREN is visible after reopen.
VAT Product Posting Group VAT19 is visible in the Universaarl VAT setup lane.
U-ITEM-HW100 target candidates were mapped as Gen. Prod. Posting Group WAREN and VAT Prod. Posting Group VAT19, but both remained blocked for posting readiness by setup-matrix boundaries.
U-ITEM-HW100 shows STK, FIFO, WARE and visible but empty Product Posting Group and VAT Product Posting Group fields.
General Product Posting Groups identify what is sold or bought; General Posting Setup combines business and product posting groups for G/L account selection.
VAT Product Posting Groups identify what is sold or bought for VAT calculation; VAT Posting Setup combines VAT business and product posting groups with VAT percent and VAT accounts.
The Gen. Product Posting Group table has a default VAT product posting group field, which supports the product-to-VAT relationship without proving Universaarl setup values by itself.

productPostingGroup.reason: WAREN is already proven as a General Product Posting Group and matches the Universaarl goods/hardware starter item. It is not enough to claim General Posting Setup or posting readiness.

vatProductPostingGroup.reason: VAT19 is the source-backed 19 percent VAT product-group candidate and is visible from the VAT setup lane. It is not enough to claim VAT Posting Setup, VAT calculation or VAT entry readiness.

lockedBoundaries: Do not change Item Posting Group / Lagerbuchungsgruppe.
Do not change Base Unit of Measure.
Do not create or change General Posting Setup.
Do not create or change VAT Posting Setup.
Do not create documents or drafts.

requiresBeforeWrite: Confirm playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE in URL and visible page context.
Open the Price/Posting or Cost/Posting FastTab where both target fields are visible.
Take a before screenshot with both fields visible.
Stop if fields are not visible, if another item is open, or if a dialog/wizard appears.
requiresAfterWrite: Capture a reopen screenshot showing WAREN and VAT19 on the item card.
Keep setupChanged=false, draftCreated=false, previewPosting=false and posted=false.

notProved: Product Posting Group WAREN is not yet saved on U-ITEM-HW100.
VAT Product Posting Group VAT19 is not yet saved on U-ITEM-HW100.
General Posting Setup INLAND/WAREN with 4400/5400 is not proven.
VAT Posting Setup INLAND/VAT19 with 19 percent and VAT accounts is not proven.
No O2C or P2P posting readiness is proven.
No Preview Posting, Posting, Item Ledger Entry, Value Entry, G/L Entry or VAT Entry is proven.
